Overview

Tepic is a city in Nayarit with a population of 425,942. Capital of Nayarit with a beautiful historic center, nearby beaches, and the famous San Pedro Lagunillas. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
